prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 79.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive stage preview on pet selection: Redesign the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring an interactive live animation preview of the chosen pet. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (60.9% completion) and long mean time (1017s); giving dynamic visual feedback helps users commit faster.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet quick controls walkthrough screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding screen illustrating basic desktop controls, how to summon or hide the pet, and interaction shortcuts. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist layout for desktop onboarding completion: Redesign the home introduction screen into a structured checklist verifying desktop permissions and pet placement. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support reported 3 cases where pets did not show up on the desktop.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet personality matching quiz sub-flow: Insert a 3-question pet personality matcher quiz right before pet selection to help users pick the best match. (why: Users take a long time on adoption (mean 1017s); guided recommendations reduce decision paralysis.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split mascot overview on path selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split layout featuring a friendly animated mascot explaining pre-made vs custom paths. (why: choose_path experiences 21.6% drop-off and high mean decision time (514s).)
5: [sign_in, hint] Previous pet recovery sign-in hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing into their account restores their previous pets. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop render readiness status on waiting screen: Display a status hint on the waiting screen confirming that desktop window and rendering permissions are active. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Official pet adoption certificate badge preview: Add a visual verified badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and needs stronger completion momentum.)
8: [home, layout] Spotlight focused layout for pet generation wait screen: Switch the waiting screen to a spotlight layout with a time estimate indicator. (why: The home wait step has high mean duration (2336s); a spotlight layout provides clear status and reduces churn.)
9: [choose_path, copy] Engaging story intro headline and call to action: Update the story intro headline and button copy to clearly explain the benefit of having an active desktop pet. (why: 21.6% of users drop off at path selection; establishing clear intent early builds momentum.)
